body:
GitHub beamfall/corvint#777, filed by the owner 2026-10-11. Related: V1-1023 (test consolidation planner, GitHub #681).

## Problem
Follow-up to #681 (consolidation planner).
`test-plan consolidate` groups *variations* by context (spec, app, setup, screen, user, org) but needs a hand-built `test-consolidation-input/0`. Teams want the inverse question answered from the existing suite: "which assertions across all tests run against the same screen in the same data state, so they can be checked once in one test?" Building that input by hand is the blocker; REUSED is unreachable from real provider documents in V0.

## Proposal
1. `corvint test-plan extract --map FILE --tests-root DIR` producing a draft `test-consolidation-input/0` from specs: each `expect(...)` becomes an assertion anchored to the screen where it runs (from the map join and preceding navigation), its setup/scenario import, acting user fixture, and read-only vs mutating classification of preceding actions; anything unclassifiable is a missing anchor (abstains).
2. A `--group-by page-state` view in `consolidate` that prints, per (screen, setup, user, prior-changes digest), the assertions from different tests that could share one visit, with the reuse blockers.

## Acceptance criteria
- Extract is deterministic and anchors every assertion; non-literal locators read unknown, not dropped.
- Assertions after a mutating action are keyed by the post-change state, never merged with pre-change ones.
- `check` on a committed plan detects drift when a spec adds or moves an assertion.
